title: Cocktail
about: A cocky ex-soldier learns flair bartending from an old pro in New York, then pours drinks on a Jamaican beach and falls for an artist.
cue: Pour the Sex on the Beach when Brian recites his barman poet poem.
faces: The barman poet's Sex on the Beach

    Pupu PlattersBeach bar jerk chicken skewersBrian tends bar on a Jamaican beach. Jerk chicken skewers with lime and habanero.How to make it700g chicken thigh fillets, cut in chunks3 tbsp jerk seasoning paste2 limes, juiced1 tbsp brown sugar2 tbsp neutral oil1 habanero chilli, finely chopped3 spring onions, sliced8 bamboo skewers, soakedMix the jerk paste, half the lime juice, sugar and oil and coat the chicken.Thread onto the skewers.Grill over high heat, turning, until charred and cooked through.Squeeze over the rest of the lime and scatter with chilli and spring onion.Coconut prawns with mango chilli dipBrian meets Jordan the artist in Jamaica. Coconut-crumbed prawns and a sweet mango chilli dip.How to make it16 large green prawns, peeled with tails on50g plain flour2 eggs60g desiccated coconut60g panko breadcrumbs500ml vegetable oil, for frying1 ripe mango, diced3 tbsp sweet chilli sauce1 lime, juicedBlitz the mango with the sweet chilli and lime for the dip.Coat the prawns in flour, egg, then the coconut and panko mixed together.Shallow-fry in batches at 180°C until golden.Drain and serve hot with the dip.Plantain chips with lime saltOn the bar from opening to last call.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.From the Fire PitEscovitch snapper for the Bonnie betDoug bets Brian he can't win Bonnie. Fried snapper under pickled chilli and onion.How to make it4 snapper fillets, skin on50g plain flour125ml neutral oil1 red onion, thinly sliced1 carrot, cut in matchsticks1 red capsicum, thinly sliced1 habanero chilli, sliced200ml white vinegar2 tsp caster sugar8 allspice berries1 tsp black peppercornsSimmer the vinegar, sugar, allspice and peppercorns, pour over the onion, carrot, capsicum and chilli and leave to pickle.Season the fish, dust with flour and fry skin-side down in the oil until crisp, then flip.Lay the fish on a platter and spoon the hot pickle over the top.Leave for a few minutes before serving so the fish soaks it up.Married to Kerry curry goatDoug turns up married to Kerry. Slow curried goat with rice and peas.How to make it1.2kg goat shoulder on the bone, cut in chunks3 tbsp Jamaican curry powder1 brown onion, diced4 garlic cloves, crushed1 tbsp grated ginger4 thyme sprigs1 habanero chilli, whole2 potatoes, diced2 tbsp neutral oil300g long-grain rice400ml coconut milk400g tin red kidney beans, drainedRub the goat with the curry powder, onion, garlic, ginger and thyme and leave for 20 minutes.Brown the goat in the oil, then cover with water, add the whole chilli and simmer gently, covered, until tender.Add the potatoes for the last 25 minutes so they thicken the sauce.Cook the rice with the coconut milk, beans, 300ml water and salt until fluffy, and serve with the curry.Sweet ReefCocktails and Dreams grilled pineappleFlanagan's Cocktails and Dreams opens. Brown sugar pineapple and coconut ice cream with lime.How to make it1 ripe pineapple, peeled and cut in thick rings60g brown sugar30g butter, melted1/2 tsp ground cinnamon500ml coconut ice cream1 lime, zested30g toasted coconut flakesBrush the pineapple with the butter and press into the sugar and cinnamon.Grill on a hot pan until caramelised on both sides.Serve warm with coconut ice cream, lime zest and toasted coconut.From the Lagoon BarThe barman poet's Sex on the BeachBrian is the world's last barman poet. Vodka and peach schnapps with orange and cranberry.How to make it160ml vodka80ml peach schnapps320ml orange juice320ml cranberry juice4 orange wheels2 cups iceShake the vodka, schnapps and orange juice hard with ice.Strain into 4 tall glasses of ice.Pour the cranberry juice slowly over the top so it sits in a layer, and add an orange wheel.Red Stripe on iceJamaica's own, cold from the cooler.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
